description: This file contains functions for parsing, rendering, and manipulating Markdown content, including handling headers, code blocks, notes, and nested structures. It is part of a utility module for Markdown processing within a larger project.

methods.name: flattenWrappedLines
methods.description: Flattens wrapped lines in Markdown content, handling code blocks and special syntax.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a hierarchical Markdown node tree from lines of Markdown text.

methods.name: parseCodeBlockMetadata
methods.description: Parses metadata from code block first lines, extracting language, title, and highlight info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse Markdown content into a node tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Markdown node tree back into Markdown text with formatting options.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Visits all nodes in a Markdown node tree with a visitor function.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits a node and its children with a visitor function.

methods.name: filterNodesForLanguage
methods.description: Filters nodes based on specified language tags in 'langs:' list within list items.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text with optional line length constraints and formatting.
